qa_pairs.question: How are raw materials and their corresponding HS codes documented when importing goods under the bonded warehouse system?
qa_pairs.answer: Under the bonded warehouse system, raw materials must be included in the license and the Utilization Declaration (UD) along with their specific HS codes to be imported duty-free, as stipulated in clause [1]. Furthermore, for production-related declarations, the description of raw materials and their corresponding HS codes must be detailed in the specified format provided in clause [3].
